title: Moving from VX - Ace to MZ, hitting a wall at a lot of the code in the plugins not being exposed, any help?

posts.author: ActuallyTheMoon
posts.body:
So I'm trying to figure out MZ coming from VX ace and I'm using the visustella plugins which are good for many things; but i'm hitting a wall in that it looks like there's some bits of the code they don't have parameters for/they don't expose
like i got as far as making the equip menu look like this (I'm trying to make menus work at a lower resolution, which they clearly weren't created for)
But for instance, i would like for the menu to not draw that stretched preview text for the equipment at all, and maybe to make the right section of the menu larger. Which i can't because Visustella doesn't have any JS parameters for those sections, and if i try to look deeper at the plugin with notepad, it seems like all the code that's actually doing thing is all in one line at the end that I can't really read.
So if i wanted to edit such details that a plugin doesn't take into account, what would be the process to figure out how to make my own "additional" plugin?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
It's very difficult to do this with VisuStella, since the code is obfuscated.
They're (as far as I know) the only major developers who do that, so if you want to be able to tweak how the plugin works or use it to learn code from, you may want to look at alternatives that do the same thing. AquaEcho has a thread with a spreadsheet dedicated to that.
You can try to just add another little plugin of your own (or someone else's) creation that overwrites the functions in the window that you want, but not knowing how the VisuStella windows are coded you have a good chance of breaking other parts of the menu.
